new_libraries.name: CircuitNexus
new_libraries.author: CircuitNexus Team
new_libraries.sentence: Official IoT library for CircuitNexus Android app (ESP32, ESP8266, Arduino Uno).
new_libraries.paragraph: Connects boards to CircuitNexus cloud via WiFi. Includes DHT helpers and ESP32-CAM stream support. Arduino Uno/Nano/Mega use an ESP8266 serial bridge. OTA for ESP32/ESP8266. Install only CircuitNexus — no separate sensor libraries needed.
